rounds.ruling: FOR connected applied learning to durable understanding more directly.
AGAINST made the stronger economic comparison.
FOR better addressed the ethical burden of assessment.
AGAINST gave the more material account of social comparability.

final.crux: Whether applied assessment gives a truer account of durable understanding.
final.verdict: FOR won three domains by tying coursework to retained knowledge and practical mastery, while AGAINST prevailed on economic and social comparability concerns.
